intro.title: Word Rush
text: Write as many words as you can for the prompt.
One paper and one pen for each team.

intro.title: Bonus cards
text: Every round has a bonus card.
It changes the points. Read it first!

intro.title: Count your words
text: 1 point for each correct word. No repeats!
The top team reads its list to prove it.

intro.title: The final round
text: The last round is always worth double.

secret.name: Super long words
secret.text: +1 for every word with 10 letters or more!

secret.name: Unique words
secret.text: +1 for every word no other team wrote!

secret.name: Z, Q or X
secret.text: +2 for every word with Z, Q or X in it!
